verses.1: And Moses said to the children of Israel, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.2: And Moses spoke to the leaders of the tribes of Israel, saying, “This is what the LORD has commanded.”
verses.3: A man who fears God will not commit any forbidden act against his conscience. He will not do anything that goes against his beliefs. Everything he says will be in accordance with what is right according to God’s laws.
verses.4: And a woman, who was devoted to Jehovah, was forbidden to do so in her father’s house, among her children.
verses.5: And her father heard her cries for help. He abolished all the restrictions that were imposed on her soul. Her father granted her all her rights and freedoms. All the restrictions that had been imposed on her soul were lifted.
verses.6: And if her father accepts her back on the day he hears all her sins and prohibitions that were imposed upon her, then no harm will happen to her. Then God will forgive her, because her father has accepted her back.
verses.7: And if she were to become a man, and her vows be made to her, or if her words were prohibited from being spoken.
verses.8: And on the day she heard this, she became happy. Her vows were fulfilled, and those who had forbidden her were punished.
verses.9: And if, on the day that she hears someone call her name and fulfill her vows that are upon her, and also her lips, which she had forbidden to be spoken, then Jehovah will forgive her.
verses.10: And all those things that were forbidden to her will be permitted again.
verses.11: And if a woman’s house is forbidden or prohibited, then it is also forbidden for her to leave that house.
verses.12: And when a woman heard this, she was freed from all her restrictions and laws that had been imposed upon her. All the prohibitions that were against her were lifted.
verses.13: And if a man breaks them, then on the day he hears all her words, he shall keep them and not kill her. Then no one will break them. And Jehovah will forgive her.
verses.14: All bonds and all restrictions that hinder a woman from fulfilling her destiny, let them be broken. Let them be freed from those constraints.
verses.15: And if the bridegroom chooses a wife for her from day to day, and fulfills all her obligations or laws that are related to her, then it’s because he chose her on the day he heard of her.
verses.16: And if the bird breaks them apart after hearing them, then it will lift its wings.
verses.17: These are the laws that Yahweh commanded Moses between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, and between their sons in their father’s household.
